brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Remittances from Russia to Azerbaijan have risen despite sanctions. [1]
Azerbaijani media claims Armenia is not ready for peace as a spat over diplomats' visit continues. [3]
Pashinyan calls Baku's portrayal of history unacceptable as Azerbaijan doubles down. [4]
Azerbaijan carries out parallel counterterrorism operations in 5 countries, detaining 10. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR AZERBAIJAN
The rise in remittances from Russia may provide economic support to Azerbaijan despite international sanctions on Russia. [1]

KEY RISKS
The claim that Armenia is not ready for peace could escalate bilateral tensions or hinder peace negotiations. [3]

WATCH ITEMS
The counterterrorism operations in 5 countries and detentions of 10 individuals may indicate ongoing or future security actions. [5]
